This substantial property offers an ideal blend of spacious living, convenience, and comfort, making it a superb choice for families or professionals seeking a well-appointed home. Upon entering, you are greeted by a welcoming atmosphere that extends throughout the property. The house features a generous reception room, providing ample space for relaxation and entertaining guests. The layout is thoughtfully designed to maximise natural light and create an inviting environment for everyday living. One of the standout features of this property is its four double bedrooms, offering versatile accommodation options. Each bedroom is well-proportioned, ensuring comfortable private spaces for all occupants. With two modern bathrooms, morning routines will be seamless, catering to the needs of a busy household. The property comes fully furnished, allowing for a hassle-free move-in experience. The furniture has been carefully selected to complement the interior, providing both style and functionality. Furthermore, the accessible loft offers valuable additional storage space, helping to keep your home clutter-free. Externally, this house truly shines. It boasts a large garden area, providing a fantastic outdoor retreat. This expansive space is perfect for children to play safely or for hosting summer barbecues. The convenience of a private driveway ensures off-street parking, a highly sought-after amenity in this popular area. Location is key, and Axminster Crescent offers an enviable position. Welling Station is just a five-minute drive away, providing excellent transport links for commuters into Central London and beyond. The area benefits from a wealth of local amenities, including shops, supermarkets, schools, and leisure facilities, all within easy reach. Everything you need for daily life is conveniently close by, enhancing the appeal of this family-friendly neighbourhood.
